candidates.name: AECpilot AI
candidates.description: At AECpilot AI, we are building a platform to solve critical efficiency and risk bottlenecks in the EPC/AEC industry. What We Do: Our AI platform fundamentally transforms high-risk, labor-intensive bidding phases, project planning/controls & contracts management. Module 1 (Schedule Generation): We automate the slow, manual process of initial planning. Our AI ingests complex tender/scope documents and automatically generates detailed L3/L4 schedules and comprehensive deliverable lists in 3-4 hours, not weeks. Module 2 (Schedule Analytics & Q&A): You can upload any project schedule and query it in natural language to run "what-if" scenarios. For example: "If our 100MT crane breaks down for 2 weeks, what is the impact on the completion date?" or "Which activities can be fast-tracked to crash the schedule?" alongwith summarization capabilities of uploaded project schedules. Module 3 (Contract Intelligence - Bid/No-Bid): AI analyzes the entire tender pdf and automatically extracts and summarizes all critical "Bid/No-Bid" parameters—such as Liquidated Damages, Liability Caps, Payment Terms, and onerous clauses. Users can ask plain-language questions about their contracts and get instant, source-cited answers. For example: "We were delayed by rain; how and when must we notify the owner to protect our EoT claim?" Module 4 (SoR/BoQ Estimation): The platform analyzes the item description, quantities, units within the tender documents. It then automatically populates a Bill of Quantities (BoQ) by fetching and applying the relevant rates from standard Schedule of Rates (SoR) documents like the CPWD DSR, providing a rapid and data-driven preliminary cost estimate. Key Advantages: Time & Cost: Drastically cuts planning time, saving significant man-hours. Accuracy & Risk: Minimizes human error, reduces missed scope, and mitigates disputes. Proactive Insights: Moves teams from reactive problem-solving to proactive, data-driven decision-making.
candidates.rationale: AECpilot offers construction-focused project planning, scheduling, contract management, and estimating software, overlapping Procore’s project-management workflows and contractor buyer base.
